dataset.title: LCS FARP

dmp.description: This project extends the development of a comprehensive system using four integrated objectives: (1) design of novel turbulence-inducing ventilation elements and CAD modeling of a ventilated protective shell; (2) comprehensive analysis of thermoplastic elastomer (TPE) and polyamide composites to optimize protection and ventilation properties; (3) computational optimization of ventilation hole placement using CFD simulation and meta-modeling methods; and (4) prototype development and physical testing using thermal dummies to validate performance indicators. The project includes a protective clothing system, from material property analysis to validation tests.
